featured.title: Evening in Beach Bapstisms
featured.description:
Beach Baptism

Join us on Sunday, November 8, after the third service for beach baptisms at 1st Street North beach access.

Details:
Date: Sunday, Nov. 8
Time: After the 11:00 AM service (third service)
Location: Meet in the auditorium with Pastor Derek before walking to the beach

What to Bring:

A bathing suit to change into
A towel
Friends and family are encouraged to join—either during service or at the beach! After your baptism, you can return to the church to rinse off with the hose (please note, no private changing area is available).

We are excited to celebrate this powerful moment with you! Register today to let us know you’ll be participating.
